legacy_compatibility: Keep Container/Node/Library/Track/Playlist and all existing CLI and library.v1 behavior unchanged. New modules wrap the current non-vendored core; no guard deletion or experimental vendor substitution.

shared_types.name: ReadLimits
shared_types.rule: Separate decoded-size cap from resident-process budget. Keep legacy512MiB plain cap unchanged; new research defaults16MiB file/plain, depth32, bounded node/JSON admission must be calibrated below512MiB RSS. Do not claim512MiB plain means512MiB RSS.

shared_types.name: FieldSpec
shared_types.rule: No automatic semantic setter for a raw slot or decoded string. Unknown intervals and unverified mask bits remain explicit.

shared_types.name: ProfileReport
shared_types.rule: Admission uses decoded shape/invariants, not fixture SHA. Digests are provenance and concurrency only; unsupported shape is a typed blocker.

shared_types.name: ScopedID
shared_types.rule: Distinguish file/master/track/album/artist/playlist/item PIDs, their local IDs, secondary IDs, playlist-local order tokens, library+domain pool IDs and sort caches.

shared_types.name: ReferenceGraph
shared_types.rule: An opaque byte match is a possible edge, not a decoded reference. No global replacement, zeroing, or deleting conservative guards before edge coverage is proven.

shared_types.name: AllocationLedger
shared_types.rule: Freeze every allocation during preparation. Pool IDs stay compact and scoped, never arbitrary64-bit PIDs. No fresh randomness during apply.

shared_types.name: PreparedMutation
shared_types.rule: Prepare on isolated state; validate all inputs before adoption/publication. Reuse frozen allocations or a sealed in-memory prepared candidate. Serialized reports are NOT blindly executable capabilities.
